neighbours.label: the article in 'the result of' and 'as a result (of)', the slot that predicts 'result', as against the same articles where no 'result' is expected
fire: Much of the flooding was the result of heavy rain in the hills.
Many shops closed as a result of the new tax on imports.
The road was blocked for hours, and traffic backed up as a result.
His success is largely the result of years of practice.
Several species vanished as a result of the drought.
The delay was the result of a computer failure at the airport.
The price of bread rose as a result of the poor harvest.
The crash was the result of driver fatigue, the report said.
quiet: Much of the flooding happened during heavy rain in the hills.
Many shops closed at the end of the summer season.
The road was blocked for hours, and the rest of the town waited.
His success came after years of practice.
Several species vanished during the long drought.
The delay was caused by a computer failure at the airport.
The price of bread rose sharply during the poor harvest.
The crash happened late at night, the report said.

predictions: fire 0.6-0.8 on 'the' or 'a' right before 'result' in a causal phrase; 'as a child', 'the end of', 'the rest of' and 'caused by' below 0.15
notes: Card: ' the' x13, ' as' x8, ' a' x8, all before 'result' / 'product'; the + pole suppresses 'result'. Probe: 'was the result of' 0.764, 'as a result of' 0.741, 'died as a result.' 0.634, 'the product of' 0.304; 'caused by' 0.146, 'died after' 0.075, 'As a child' 0.001, 'as a teacher' 0.001.
